title: Recommendation
description: The decision-layer record for one market at one research run: what EdgeLab/the model concluded, and whether a bet followed. Every observed eligible market gets exactly one of these per run, including markets never evaluated at all.

recommendationId.description: sha1(runId + marketTicker) when a ticker resolved, else sha1(runId + gameId + marketName) — a market the pipeline could not even map to a ticker is still recorded, just without that field

marketTicker.description: Null only for NOT_EVALUATED/INSUFFICIENT_MODEL_SUPPORT/PASS_DATA_QUALITY rows where no Kalshi ticker could be mapped at all — never fabricated

marketName.description: The model's own market name (e.g. config/rules.json's 'F5_ML_Away'), when this row originates from the 11-market model config rather than full-universe observation

modelEvaluationId.description: Link to the ModelEvaluation this decision was based on

rankWithinGame.description: 1-based rank among this game's recommended/watch candidates

priceCeiling.description: Bet-up-to price, if the decision layer computed one

passReason.description: Required (non-null) when status starts with PASS_

comparisonMarkets.description: Other marketTickers considered as alternative expressions of the same thesis

betId.description: Link to the PlacedBet, when betPlaced is true

tickerResolutionStatus.description: Distinguishes the previously-overloaded marketTicker=null (and previously-unverified marketTicker!=null) into a specific reason -- see lib.edgelab.recommendations.classify_ticker_resolution. RESOLVED: marketTicker is a real archived MarketObservation ticker for this exact game (pipeline-derived rows are cross-checked against the date's archived corpus; full-universe extension rows ARE that corpus, so are always RESOLVED). NOT_APPLICABLE: no ticker was ever expected (no market of this kind exists for this game). NOT_COMPUTED: the pipeline hasn't produced a ticker yet, but plausibly could. PARSER_UNRESOLVED: a claimed ticker does not exist anywhere in this date's archived MarketObservation corpus -- never trusted as 'the exact archived ticker'. AMBIGUOUS: a claimed ticker DOES exist in the archive, but for a different gameId than this row claims -- two different things both claiming to be the same market, so neither is trusted. Null only for records written before this field existed.

thresholdDisplay.description: Natural sportsbook-style label for a totals-shaped market's threshold, e.g. 'Over 3.5', 'Under 7.5', 'Team Total Over 4.5' -- see lib.edgelab.recommendations.format_threshold_label. Null for markets with no threshold (ML, NRFI/YRFI) and for literal Kalshi N+ count markets (pitcher/hitter props), which keep their own correct 'N+' wording elsewhere and are never relabeled here.
